figurative_meaning_bn: ভয়, উদ্বেগ ইত্যাদির জন্য বুকের মধ্যে অব্যক্ত কম্পনধ্বনি
figurative_meaning_en: An indistinct vibrating sound in the chest due to fear, anxiety, etc.
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার আগে উদ্বেগে বুক দুরদুর করলো।
example_sentences_in_english: His heart is pounding with fear.
Her stomach was fluttering with anxiety before the exam.
note: This is an onomatopoeic idiom commonly used to describe physical manifestations of fear in everyday Bengali speech.
